text:
maya_support: FYI customer reports major mismatch between dedicated reservation hours and invoice charges — dashboard shows 1,200 reserved GPU hours used for pool-pdx-7 between 2025-11-01 and 2025-11-30 but invoice line item reads 1,350 GPU hours. Customer also says token usage is tiny so burst shouldn't account for +150 hours. Can we triage?
kevin_billing: Which account/invoice? Do we have the pool id and invoice line item id? Also ask customer if they saw any large backfills or migrations.
sam_customer_ops: Account: ACME-42. Invoice: INV-2025-11-ACME-42. Pool: pool-pdx-7. They confirmed no migration on their side; said traffic pattern was flat. Sent request_id examples: req_42_20251112_7a2f and req_42_20251120_b9c1.
maya_support: Attached their csv of peak jobs (small). They attached a screenshot of the UI showing Reserved hours: 1,200; Billed GPU hours: 1,350; Burst hours: 0 on UI.
billing-bot: invoice-processor: Invoice INV-2025-11-ACME-42 processed at 2025-12-03T04:12Z. Line items: dedicated_reserved: 1200h @ rate, dedicated_overage: 150h @ overage rate. Credits: 0.
jess_reliability: ok I'm going to pull metering events for pool-pdx-7. Likely causes: (1) metering consumer double-emitted during an agent restart, (2) billing window boundary misalignment + timezone rounding, (3) allocation of paused instances counted as live if not drained. I'll run the query and check ingest logs.
jess_reliability: Query (clickhouse) I'll run:
```
SELECT event_type, sum(gpu_hours) as hours, toStartOfHour(ts) as h
FROM metering.events
WHERE pool_id = 'pool-pdx-7' AND ts BETWEEN '2025-11-01' AND '2025-12-01'
GROUP BY event_type, h
ORDER BY h
```
kevin_billing: Also export invoice calculation JSON for that invoice so we can match line items to source counters.
maya_support: Customer asked if SLA credits could appear later — they expected credits for downtime in Nov.
kevin_billing: SLA credits are applied as negative line items but sometimes posted on next invoice cycle depending on cutover. We should still reconcile the +150 before concluding it's credits.
jess_reliability: I see spikes on 2025-11-14 03:00-04:00 UTC where metering shows ~140 extra gpu_hours emitted over a single hour in pool-pdx-7. There's an adjacent consumer restart in logs at 2025-11-14T03:05Z with duplicate checkpoint replay flagged. That looks like duplicate emission.
jess_reliability: checking idempotency keys — some events had null idempotency_key and were reprocessed during the restart.
kevin_billing: If duplicate emission maps to billed overage, we need to reverse charge on INV or issue a credit. Please open a billing adjustment PR and tag accounting.
maya_support: I'll ask customer if they need an immediate credit while we process or prefer adjustment on next invoice.
kevin_billing: For the fix: (a) create credit for 150h, (b) patch metering consumer to enforce idempotency on replays, (c) add an alert when a single-hour emission > 10x baseline. I'll log these as action items.
sam_customer_ops: Appreciate the quick look. If you can confirm the 150h is duplication, we can accept a credit on current invoice.
jess_reliability: Action items: 1) produce event-level dump for 2025-11-14 02:00-05:00 for pool-pdx-7 and send to accounting (CSV), 2) deploy idempotency patch to metering-consumer (PR #4892), 3) create alert rule (monitors#720). I'll attach the CSV shortly.
maya_support: Filed ticket SUP-2025-ACME-42-07 and added all artifacts. Accounting and customer notified.
kevin_billing: I'll prepare a credit memo for 150h and link to INV-2025-11-ACME-42. If accounting approves, we can issue immediate refund or apply to next invoice per customer preference.
maya_support: Customer wants credit applied now. They also asked for a short note explaining cause.
jess_reliability: I'll draft a brief root-cause note: duplicate metering events emitted during consumer restart due to missing idempotency keys; patch rolling out now.
kevin_billing: Thanks. I'll mark invoice as disputed internally until credit is posted.
maya_support: Closing loop with customer now; will update thread when credit is posted. :thumbsup:
